# Kristal Dentale Clinic

> Professional dental clinic located in Oke Aro, Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria.

## Overview
Kristal Dentale Clinic is a dental practice in Akure, Ondo State, providing general, restorative, orthodontic, and cosmetic dental care for children and adults. Clinical care is led by Dr. Olupona (Lead Clinician & Practice Director) with a patient-focused approach centered on clear communication, thorough diagnosis, and comfortable treatment.

## Clinic Information
- **Practice Name**: Kristal Dentale Clinic
- **Lead Clinician**: Dr. Olupona (Lead Clinician & Practice Director)

## Dental Services & Treatments
- [Orthodontics](https://kristaldentaleclinic.com.ng/services/orthodontics): Treatment to improve tooth alignment, spacing, and bite relationships using appropriate orthodontic appliances.
- [Bridges & Crowns](https://kristaldentaleclinic.com.ng/services/bridges-and-crowns): Restorative ceramic crowns for damaged teeth and fixed dental bridges for replacing missing teeth.
- [Dental Veneers](https://kristaldentaleclinic.com.ng/services/veneers): Custom cosmetic coverings designed to improve the color, shape, and appearance of selected teeth.
- [Scaling & Polishing](https://kristaldentaleclinic.com.ng/services/scaling-and-polishing): Professional dental cleaning to remove plaque, calculus, and tartar, supporting healthy gums.
- [Teeth Whitening](https://kristaldentaleclinic.com.ng/services/teeth-whitening): In-clinic professional whitening treatments to brighten stained or discolored teeth.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://kristaldentaleclinic.com.ng/services/cosmetic-dentistry): Aesthetic treatments tailored to enhance smile appearance following clinical assessment.
- [Dental Implants](https://kristaldentaleclinic.com.ng/services/dental-implants): Permanent tooth replacement solutions providing stable anchors for replacement teeth where clinically appropriate.
- [Tooth Extraction](https://kristaldentaleclinic.com.ng/services/tooth-extraction): Careful tooth removal when restoration is not clinically viable, performed with appropriate pain management.
- [Dental Fillings](https://kristaldentaleclinic.com.ng/services/dental-filling): Composite tooth-colored restorations for teeth affected by decay, cavities, or minor damage.
